en.headline: Charger fire at So Uk Estate injures three and kills four cats
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze in a ninth-floor flat at Carnation House before dawn after a portable charger overheated; about 80 residents were evacuated.
body: A fire broke out shortly before 3 a.m. on Thursday in a ninth-floor flat at Carnation House, So Uk Estate, in Cheung Sha Wan. Police received a report at 2:51 a.m. from a woman who said a portable charger, commonly known as a power bank, in her home had begun to smoke and catch fire. She left the unit; neighbours also reported smoke and two residents in an adjacent flat said they were trapped.

Firefighters arrived with a hose line and a breathing-apparatus team, raised an aerial ladder and extinguished the fire at 3:29 a.m. About 80 residents were evacuated. Three people — two women and a man — were taken conscious to Caritas Medical Centre after reporting dizziness, smoke inhalation or difficulty breathing while escaping. Security Road was temporarily closed.

Four household cats were found unconscious in the flat of origin. Firefighters administered chest compressions and oxygen, but all four died. Staff from the Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals later collected the animals. A preliminary investigation by the Fire Services Department indicated that an external charger overheated and started the fire. Officers said there was no evidence at this stage that the case was criminal.

zh.headline: 蘇屋邭充電器起火三人送院 單位四貓不治
zh.dek: 長沙灣蘇屋邭石竹樓九樓單位清晨充電器過熱起火，消防約半小時救熄，約80人疏散，三人送院，單位內四隻家貓搶救後不治。
body: 周四凌晨近3時，長沙灣蘇屋邭石竹樓一單位發生火警。警方於凌晨2時51分接獲一名女子報案，指其九樓住所內的流動充電器冒煙起火，她隨即離開單位。其後有鄰居報稱走廊濃煙，另有鄰近單位兩名住戶報稱被困。
消防出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊撲救，並升起雲梯，於凌晨3時29分將火救熄。約80名居民需要疏散。一名男子及兩名女子報稱頭暈、吸入濃煙或不適，清醒被送往明愛醫院治理。保安道一度封閉。
消防在起火單位救出四隻陷入昏迷的家貓，即場進行心外壓並使用氧氣罩搶救，最終全部不治。愛護動物協會職員其後將貓隻遺體運走。消防初步調查相信外置充電器過熱起火，現階段沒有證據顯示案件涉及刑事成分。
